entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for this new cycling jersey and... it just doesn't fit. I feel terrible.

I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the fit?

It's the fit. It's the wrong size for me, I guess. The jersey is just way too tight across the chest. I've been a loyal customer for years and I was so excited for this, and now... I really needed that money for other things, you know?
I completely understand your frustration, and I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. Let me pull up your order information. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure. It's for Sarah Jenkins, order number VF78901.
Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the Pro-Line Aero Jersey, delivered 16 days ago. I'm just checking our return policy for you.
I just hope I can get my money back. I was really counting on it.

Of course. And good news, Sarah. I see here that your jersey is a standard item and falls well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process this for you. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to do an exchange for a larger size?
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief! Thank you so much, David. An exchange would be perfect, I'd love to try the next size up.

Excellent choice. I've just initiated the exchange process for you. I'm sending an email to you right now with a prepaid return label. Just pack the jersey that's too tight back in its original packaging if you can, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll ship out the new size immediately.
That's wonderful. You've really turned my day around. Thank you.
It's my pleasure, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
